name: Deyang
scopeLimits: Bounded city-source review only. No citywide completeness is claimed. At most three complete public parcel polygons are retained. No owner or address fields and no credentials or token values are retained.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: The city registration center publishes active real-property registration services and explicitly documents a citywide public cadastral-map visualization viewer. This confirms a Deyang registry source; it does not establish a public vector download or the exact footprint of the WUP locator.
technicalBlocker: The official guide links an anonymous public cadastral map, but its client/service schema and full polygon response were not inspectable in this run. A local shell request timed out and the browser fetch did not access the map shell; that is inconclusive about origin availability. The guide also directs personal property-detail lookups through an identity-authenticated WeChat route, which was not used.
remainingUncertainty: Whether the current viewer exposes complete parcel polygons through a public API and what reuse terms apply. The WUP point has not been tested against a returned parcel feature.
